university_courses.title: CS224N: Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning
university_courses.description: Stanford's flagship NLP course covering word vectors, neural networks for NLP, dependency parsing, RNNs, attention, transformers, pretraining (BERT, GPT), and current research topics including large language models.
university_courses.prerequisites: Machine Learning (CS229 or equivalent), Python, calculus, linear algebra
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Word Vectors & Word2Vec
2. Neural Classifiers
3. Backpropagation
4. Dependency Parsing
5. Language Models & RNNs
6. Seq2Seq & Attention
7. Transformers
8. Pretraining (BERT, GPT)
9. Question Answering
10. Text Generation
11. Coreference Resolution
12. Large Language Models

university_courses.title: CS11-711: Advanced NLP
university_courses.description: Carnegie Mellon advanced NLP course covering state-of-the-art methods in NLP including text generation, structured prediction, low-resource NLP, and multilingual models. Emphasis on reading and understanding current research papers.
university_courses.prerequisites: Introduction to NLP or equivalent, deep learning fundamentals
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Text Classification
2. Language Modeling
3. Sequence Labeling
4. Machine Translation
5. Structured Prediction
6. Transfer Learning
7. Interpretability
8. Low-Resource NLP
9. Multilinguality
10. Text Generation

university_courses.title: 6.8610: Quantitative Methods for NLP
university_courses.description: MIT course on quantitative and computational approaches to natural language processing. Covers probabilistic models, neural approaches, and evaluation methodology for NLP systems.
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Introduction to NLP
2. Language Models
3. Text Classification
4. Sequence Models
5. Parsing
6. Semantics
7. Machine Translation
8. Question Answering
9. Dialogue Systems
10. Ethics in NLP

university_courses.title: COMP 550: Natural Language Processing
university_courses.description: McGill University course providing a broad introduction to NLP covering tokenization, POS tagging, parsing, semantics, discourse, machine translation, and applications.
university_courses.prerequisites: Data structures, algorithms, probability, linear algebra
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Text Processing
2. Language Modeling
3. POS Tagging
4. Syntax & Parsing
5. Semantics
6. Information Extraction
7. Machine Translation
8. Sentiment Analysis
9. Question Answering
10. Summarization

university_courses.title: Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing
university_courses.description: University of Oxford course on deep learning methods for NLP. Covers word embeddings, RNNs, CNNs for text, attention mechanisms, and transformer architectures.
university_courses.prerequisites: Machine learning, linear algebra, Python programming
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Word Embeddings
2. Recurrent Neural Networks
3. Convolutional Models for Text
4. Attention Mechanisms
5. Transformer Architecture
6. Pre-trained Models
7. Text Generation
8. Language Understanding

university_courses.title: Arabic Natural Language Processing
university_courses.description: Specialised course on computational processing of Arabic language, covering morphological analysis, dialectal Arabic processing, Arabic text classification, sentiment analysis, and machine translation for Arabic.
university_courses.prerequisites: Introduction to NLP, Arabic language skills (helpful but not required)
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Arabic Morphology & Tokenization
2. Arabic POS Tagging
3. Arabic Named Entity Recognition
4. Dialectal Arabic Processing
5. Arabic Sentiment Analysis
6. Arabic Machine Translation
7. Arabic Text Summarization
8. Arabic Language Models (CAMeLBERT, AraBERT)

university_courses.title: Introduction to NLP with Transformers
university_courses.description: Practical course from Hugging Face covering the transformer architecture, tokenizers, fine-tuning pre-trained models, and deploying NLP solutions. Free and open access.
university_courses.prerequisites: Python programming, basic machine learning concepts
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Transformer Models
2. Using Transformers
3. Fine-Tuning Pretrained Models
4. Sharing Models
5. The Datasets Library
6. The Tokenizers Library
7. Main NLP Tasks
8. Building NLP Demos

university_courses.title: Speech and Language Processing
university_courses.description: Comprehensive online textbook and course materials by Dan Jurafsky and James H. Martin covering the full spectrum of NLP: regular expressions, language models, sequence labeling, parsing, semantics, discourse, dialogue, and MT.
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Regular Expressions & Automata
2. N-gram Language Models
3. Naive Bayes & Sentiment
4. Logistic Regression
5. Neural Networks
6. POS Tagging
7. Constituency & Dependency Parsing
8. Semantics & Word Senses
9. Machine Translation
10. Question Answering & Chatbots

university_courses.title: Multilingual NLP
university_courses.description: Course focused on NLP techniques for multilingual and cross-lingual settings. Covers language-agnostic representations, cross-lingual transfer, multilingual transformers, and evaluation across languages including Arabic.
university_courses.prerequisites: NLP fundamentals, deep learning, linear algebra
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Multilingual Representations
2. Cross-lingual Transfer
3. Multilingual Transformers (mBERT, XLM-R)
4. Machine Translation
5. Morphological Typology
6. Low-Resource Languages
7. Evaluation Across Languages
8. Arabic & Semitic Language Processing

university_courses.title: Text Mining and Analytics
university_courses.description: Course from UIUC covering text mining, information retrieval, topic modeling, text clustering, sentiment analysis, and opinion mining with applications to real-world datasets.
university_courses.syllabus:
1. Natural Language Content Analysis
2. Text Representation
3. Word Association Mining
4. Topic Modeling (PLSA, LDA)
5. Text Clustering
6. Text Categorization
7. Sentiment Analysis & Opinion Mining
8. Text-Based Prediction

coursera_courses.title: Natural Language Processing Specialization
coursera_courses.description: DeepLearning.AI specialization on Coursera covering classification, vector spaces, sequence models, attention mechanisms, and transformers for NLP. Taught by Younes Bensouda Mourri and Łukasz Kaiser.

coursera_courses.title: Machine Learning with Python
coursera_courses.description: IBM course on Coursera covering supervised and unsupervised ML, regression, classification, and clustering with Python and scikit-learn.

coursera_courses.title: Deep Learning Specialization
coursera_courses.description: DeepLearning.AI specialization teaching neural networks, hyperparameter tuning, CNNs, RNNs, and sequence models. Essential foundation for NLP deep learning.

coursera_courses.title: Introduction to Large Language Models
coursera_courses.description: Google Cloud introductory course on LLMs covering what they are, use cases, prompt tuning, and Google tools for LLM development.

coursera_courses.title: Applied Text Mining in Python
coursera_courses.description: University of Michigan course covering text mining, NLP with NLTK, topic modeling, text classification, and information extraction.

coursera_courses.title: Prompt Engineering for ChatGPT
coursera_courses.description: Vanderbilt University course on prompt engineering patterns, chain-of-thought, few-shot learning, and effective interaction with large language models.

coursera_courses.title: Arabic for Beginners (with NLP Context)
coursera_courses.description: Introductory Arabic language course valuable for NLP practitioners working with Arabic text processing, morphology, and tokenization.
